DATO' SRI HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

Menteri Kerja Raya

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(BUKIT KAYU HITAM-JITRA HIGHWAY) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2016

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the

Federal Roads (Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister

makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (Bukit Kayu Hitam-Jitra Highway) (Amendment) Order 2016.

(2) This Order is deemed to have come into operation on 12 January 2012.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls)

(Bukit Kayu Hitam-Jitra Highway) Order 1989 [P.U. (A) 16/1989], which is referred to as

the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended in subparagraph 2(1)—

(a) by substituting for the words "Projek Lebuh Raya Utara-Selatan Berhad"

the words "Projek Lebuh Raya Usahasama Berhad";

(b) by substituting for the words "1 January 2002 to 31 May 2030" the words

"12 January 2012 to 31 December 2038"; and

(c) by substituting for the words "column (2) of the First Schedule, the

appropriate tolls specified in column (2) of the First Schedule according to

the concession years as specified in column (1) thereof" the words

"column (1) of the First Schedule, the appropriate tolls specified in

column (2)".

Substitution of First Schedule

3. The principal Order is amended by substituting for the First Schedule the

following Schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE

[Subparagraph 2(1)]

RATES OF TOLLS FOR THE PERIOD FROM 12 JANUARY 2012 UNTIL 31 DECEMBER 2016

(1)

Classes of Vehicles

(2)

Toll Payable

(RM)

1. Vehicle with two axles and three or four wheels

(excluding taxi and bus)

3.60

2. Vehicle with two axles and five or six wheels

(excluding bus)

5.30

3. Vehicle with three axles or more (excluding bus) 7.20

4. Taxi 1.70

5. Bus 2.60

For the purpose of calculating the number of axles and wheels of a vehicle, the axles and

wheels of any trailer towed by the vehicle shall be calculated as part of the axles and

wheels of the vehicle.".

Made 11 May 2016

[KKR.PUU. 110-1/7/1; PN(PU2)426/LX]

DATO' SRI HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

Minister of Works
